description: Slice 1: YAML config loading and patch application.

scenarios.description: Load a base YAML config with no layers; output is the parsed entry list rendered as YAML with source labels.

input.base:
- id: shared
  name: ./noop.mjs
  config:
    value: base
    key: !!js process.env.X
- id: untouched
  name: ./noop.mjs

scenarios.description: Apply a single patch layer to base entries; output is the patched entry list rendered as YAML with source-and-patches labels.
